subject: Initial MAP draft + trial readiness checklist
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Lambert <sofia.lambert@tidewaterlabs.com>, Ethan Zhao <e.zhao@tidewaterlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP draft + trial readiness checklist

Hi Sofia / Ethan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I’m sharing an initial mutual action plan (MAP) stub and a short trial-readiness checklist so we can align next steps and avoid rework during the pilot. The doc is intentionally light — the goal for our next 48 hours is to agree on stakeholders, acceptance criteria, and a tight 21–30 day validation window.

What I’ve included:
- MAP draft (Google Doc) — purpose, success metrics, owner roles, and milestone dates
- Trial readiness checklist (XLSX) — infra requirements, test datasets, security gating, and contact owners
- A starter slide deck with suggested demo agenda and acceptance criteria (attached)

Please take a quick pass and comment in-line on the MAP doc by EOD Thursday. Ben (cc’d) will propose technical pre-reqs; Marissa will capture CS/operational owners and the acceptance rubric.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqMapDraft/edit
Attachments: 2027-04-07_MAP_template_v1.gslides (slides stub), trial-readiness-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Proposed milestone highlights (subject to your edits):
- Week 0 (days 0–3): Confirm stakeholders & access, baseline dataset delivery
- Week 1 (days 4–10): Demo + integration smoke tests, initial latency/cost baseline
- Week 2–3 (days 11–24): Iteration on prompts, stability checks, acceptance runs
- Day 25–30: Acceptance review and go/no-go

Open items for you:
1) Can you confirm the primary technical owner on your side? (I suspect Ethan, but please confirm)
2) Any mandatory security artifacts we should include up front beyond the checklist?

I’ll set a 30-min sync for tomorrow to walk the doc if that helps — sending a tentative invite now.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mon: (415) 555-0123

From: Sofia Lambert <sofia.lambert@tidewaterlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Zhao <e.zhao@tidewaterlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft + trial readiness checklist

Thanks Monica — appreciate the quick turnaround.

A couple quick things from Tidewater:
- Confirming Ethan will lead technical workstreams; I’ll be the exec sponsor and will be involved in acceptance reviews.
- For security: our InfoSec team requires an inventory of data types and a clear retention policy (we can send a short questionnaire). Can you add a row in the checklist for retention & encryption-at-rest details?
- On milestones: can we tighten Week 1 to include a scripted acceptance scenario (happy-path) so we have objective early signal?

I made two inline comments in the doc and added suggested acceptance metrics (precision @1 on our sample, 95th percentile latency threshold).

Sofia Lambert
Director of Data Science | Tidewater Labs
sofia.lambert@tidewaterlabs.com

- Tech owner: Ethan (confirmed)
- Baseline infra: 2x T4s for the pilot (will scale if you need burst); network egress patterns documented in the checklist
- Scripted happy-path: I added a small test plan (3 end-to-end scenarios) that we can run during Week 1; outcome = pass/fail with measured latency and output match rate

I also threw together two starter slides for the demo agenda and acceptance gates — no deck polish, just to align on content.

Appreciate the quick reviews — this is shaping up nicely. Finalizing next steps below so we have clear owners: 

Action items:
- Tidewater: confirm any InfoSec questionnaire items by Monday morning (Sofia / InfoSec)
- Ethan (Tidewater): provide test dataset sample (anonymized) and confirm access method (S3 link or secure transfer) by Monday EOD
- Ben: finalize demo slides and upload a polished 2-slide acceptance rubric by Monday noon (attached)
- Marissa: create the acceptance review calendar (30-min) for day 26 and invite all stakeholders
- Monica: coordinate contract milestone language after acceptance gates are finalized; I’ll draft a short addendum for pilot terms

I’ve updated the MAP doc with the new technical plan and added timelines reflecting the scripted happy-path in Week 1. If there are no objections, we’ll lock Milestone dates on Monday and start Week 0 tasks immediately.

Tentative sync: Mon, Apr 11 — 10:00am PT (I sent a calendar invite).

Thanks all — looking forward to momentum on this.

Monica Patel | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
